current_embedded_holdout.reason: The embedded 30-case HOLDOUT contents were inspected during PR review. They remain useful as a stable regression checkpoint but must not be represented as blind evidence for a tuner or reviewer that has seen them.

blind_holdout_registration.partition_rule: Partition by scenario/source group before case rendering; do not split near-duplicate rendered cases independently.
blind_holdout_registration.near_duplicate_rule: Reject registration when a HOLDOUT case is a wording-only near duplicate of a DEV/exposed-regression case with the same decision boundary and evidence shape.
blind_holdout_registration.exposure_rule: Case bodies and expected behaviors stay inaccessible to candidate tuning until registration is closed. Only registration identity, aggregate counts and required coverage may be visible before evaluation.
blind_holdout_registration.result_rule: Blind results are admissible only when the registered bundle/candidate/judge identities match the executed run exactly. Infrastructure failures are reported separately and never converted into model-quality failures or passes.

lifecycle_usage.DEV: Tune and debug on DEV only.
lifecycle_usage.EXPOSED_REGRESSION_CHECKPOINT: Run continuously for regression after changes; never call it blind.
lifecycle_usage.BLIND_HOLDOUT: Run only from a closed registration satisfying this policy.
lifecycle_usage.POST_SHIP_DRIFT: Reuse registered scenario families or new sealed samples with identity binding; compare drift only across compatible bundle/candidate/judge identities.
